evidence: The sports manifest registers the six page descriptors. The warmup animation installs separate pause, continue and end controls; pause and continue share one state-changing callback. The ephemeris update view registers information and update callbacks, the latter checks connection before navigation or prompt. The descriptor-root and page-state cleanup paths are separately audited.
scope: Recorded shared UI and event calls only; training algorithms, GPS, network transfer and stored ephemeris data are outside these points.
limitations: Altering event callbacks can interrupt timers, navigation, position data updates or page cleanup. Displayed information may diverge from actual device state. Root and state guards are not thread barriers; device behavior and recovery remain unverified.
